decision.explanation: The query asks for the location of 'Lincoln County High School'. The instruction mandates preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers rather than selecting a single 'winner' based on familiarity or majority. D1S1 places the school in Stanford, Kentucky. D2S1 places a school with the same name in Springfield, Illinois (despite the parenthetical '(Kentucky)' in the header, the text asserts the location). D3S1 and D5S3 place a school in Hamlin, West Virginia. 'Hamlin, WV' (C3) and 'Hamlin, West Virginia' (C2) are semantically equivalent but represent distinct string forms provided in the sources; both are retained to ensure complete coverage of the provided answer forms. All four answers correspond directly to the 'place' slot requested.
